prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn the essential shortcuts and clicks to interact with or hide your new pet.", "Right-click pet for main menu", "Double-click to start chat or action", "Got It"]
1: ["Initializing desktop physics, render engine, and sprite animations..."]
2: ["Practice Hiding and Showing Your Pet", "Try minimizing your pet to the system tray and bringing it back now.", "Complete Practice"]
3: ["Custom pet generation takes about 1-2 minutes. Ensure bright lighting for best results."]
4: ["Chatting With Your Pet", "Click your pet anytime to start a conversation or issue voice commands.", "Type or speak to give tasks, ask questions, or play games.", "Start Using Pet"]
5: ["Sign in with your previous account to automatically restore all existing pets and progress.", "Account Sync Active"]
6: []
7: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion", "Look for the pet icon in your system tray at the bottom corner of your screen."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Hub", "Your pet is live on your screen. Learn essential controls and customize your companion settings.", "Explore Quick Controls", "Finish Setup"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your pet companion is created and permanently linked to your profile."]
